refinements.detail: No implementation defect; only remedy was raising the sound-speed factor (tuning) — flag stands.
Fixed Taylor–Green non-equilibrium initialisation factor and pressure-outlet instability.

waves.name: Wave 0 · Research
waves.detail: 4 researcher agents in parallel; 72 open sources; exact solvers validated (Sod vs sodshock 1e-16; Kepler invariants 2e-14).

waves.name: Pilot
waves.detail: stormer-verlet@kepler-e06 built, independently reviewed (matched) and re-run by the orchestrator before scaling.

waves.name: Wave 1 · Integrators + incompressible
waves.detail: explicit/symplectic Euler, RK4, LBM, ψ–ω FD, Stable Fluids: 6 builders, 13 reviews, 1 refinement with code change → fresh re-review of all LBM experiments.

waves.name: Wave 1b · LBM re-verification
waves.detail: Code changed by refinement → 5 fresh reviewers re-ran every LBM experiment. TG and cylinder 2D-1 moved flagged → matched; cylinder 2D-2 remains flagged (staircase default; interpolated bounce-back option passes). No further defect found, loop closed.

waves.name: Coverage fill
waves.detail: stable-fluids@cavity-re1000 had not been scheduled; one independent reviewer added (flagged: psi_min 48% low, semi-Lagrangian dissipation dominates).

waves.name: Wave 2 · Particle methods
waves.detail: WCSPH, PBF, MLS-MPM: 3 builders, 4 reviews, 1 refinement (declined: no defect).

waves.name: Wave 3 · Hyperbolic
waves.detail: Lax–Friedrichs, HLLC-Godunov, MUSCL–Hancock, HLL-SWE: 4 builders, 5 reviews. Two reviewers independently caught a factor-2 error in the Sod energy reference.

waves.name: Interface refresh
waves.detail: Lab republished after each wave; Live wall runs every scene concurrently.
